description: Render a slab from the Austin yard onto a photo of the user's own kitchen or bath, and return the image with a price estimate. Pass a public image URL of the room (JPEG/PNG/WebP) and a stone slug from search_stones. Rendering takes about 30-90 seconds; if it is not ready in time, call get_visualization with the returned id. Optional cabinet_wood / hardware_finish (from list_finishes) preview a different cabinet finish or hardware; visualization only, we don't sell cabinets or hardware.

cabinet_wood.description: Visualization only (we don't sell cabinets). One of: keep, white-oak, red-oak, walnut, cherry, maple, hickory, painted-white, painted-navy, painted-greige, painted-sage. Default keep.

hardware_finish.description: Visualization only (we don't sell hardware). One of: keep, matte-black, brushed-nickel, brushed-brass, polished-chrome, oil-rubbed-bronze, unlacquered-brass. Default keep.

room_image_url.description: Public URL of a photo of the room, countertops visible

sqft.description: Countertop square feet, for the price estimate

name: visualize_kitchen
title: See a stone on your kitchen
